scope: Proposition 4.4 of the manuscript “A rational obstruction to strong chromatic splitting at height three” (preprints/A-rational-obstruction-to-strong-chromatic-splitting-at-height-three-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d0bd23f35dc42a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The tautological quotient of E2 and its composite with f give maps mn : T → Mn and an exact sequence 0 −→ ker(f) −→ V3 −→ V2 −→ 0. (4.2) These are slope-zero bundles. Their corresponding rational local systems form an exact sequence of ranks 1, 3, 2. With the induced determinant lattices this sequence is classified by a map d : T → BCD, where D = {( a v 0 A ) : a ∈ Z× p , A ∈ J2, v ∈ Q1×2 p } ≃ Q2 p ⋊ (Z× p × J2). The classifying maps of V3 and V2 are the composites of d with the relative maps induced by the inclusion ρ3 : D ↪ J3 and projection ρ2 : D → J2. The Pn-classifying map of mn is the composite T π − → YC → BCPn induced by qn : G → Pn.
